C0070.title: Unfair Competition Case Involving the 'Shengqianzhao' Price Comparison Plugin
C0070.summary: In November 2021, analysis indicated that price comparison plugins redirecting user traffic from third-party websites to other platforms undermine competitor user stickiness, constituting unfair competition. Such plugins embed themselves in third-party sites to induce users to jump to other shopping platforms for price comparison and purchase.

references.title: Unfair competition (VII) — Embedding plugins on third-party websites to induce redirects to other sites - Zhihu
